issue_body:
### Mathematical Target

Prove the numerical normalization needed to obtain the fourth-root rate in
paper `lem:qld-unitary`, section 14, lines 1669-1685, from the existing
global-pair producer and concrete-unitary extraction theorem. Choose all
universal constants internally, before the admissible parameters and
strategy. Produce a global witness at `deltaQld a b epsilon m d q` and an
extraction witness at `deltaExtract C (deltaQld a b epsilon m d q) m d q`,
without the extra nested `deltaConstructPaulis` argument in the latter.

Keep the seed-indexed and direct-carrier domain qualifications explicit.
This task does not establish the subsequent isometry transfer or final
Pauli-test soundness theorem.

### Existing Work and Dependencies

PR #584 at `cc6de210a467960b0fd207a4d2a91efd9ba1d277` provides the internally
composed witness at the nested construction/extraction scale and has an
independent approval. Its branch must not be edited by this task. Work in a
new stacked branch pinned to that commit until the parent is integrated.

Reuse `deltaQld_mono` and the already-proved scalar absorption
`deltaExtract_le_deltaQld` from completed issue #241 / PR #249. The latter
bounds the composed error by a new final robustness family; it does not
itself identify the same-parameter fourth-root rate printed in
`lem:qld-unitary`. First check for an existing theorem that already proves
the exact new target. If one exists, report its statement and verified
source correspondence instead of adding duplicate declarations.

### Acceptance and Bound

Preserve the existing nested constructor and all public contracts. Add no
load-bearing public hypothesis, supplied-global-witness assumption, axiom,
proof hole, or conditional package to avoid proving the estimate. Any
necessary witness weakening must be proved from its actual fields.

Use a small support theorem or module with minimal exports and accurate
blueprint and paper-gap documentation. Retain existing conditional markers
and source-domain restrictions. Check the original paper before editing,
then focused Lean, fresh axiom closure, affected imports, blueprint links
and normal hooks. No full CI or publication in the author assignment.

One fresh Sol/Ultra assignment, at most 900 seconds from actual task start,
with the final 180 seconds reserved for validation, commit and receipt.
No automatic second attempt or reset of the historical issue #123 / #241
budgets. If the proof is unfinished, retain a precise checkpoint and stop.

Subtask of issue #123. A successful local packet still requires ordinary
publication, exact-head CI and independent review before integration.
